study: Learned treatment rules with an intermediate held at each level

configuration.fit: TMLE(learned_rule=LearnedRule(), n_folds=10, cv_evaluation=True, targeting_scheme='pooled', g_bounds='auto', random_state=<fold seed>).fit(..., intermediate='Z') at n = 2000; every other setting the constructor's default; repeats=1
configuration.known_rule: the same estimator with learned_rule=None and interventions=[Rule(1{W1 > 0}, rule_kind='known')]: the fold-evaluated controlled-direct-effect path
configuration.rule: 1{Qbar_v(1, z, w) > Qbar_v(0, z, w)} of each fold's outcome model at each level z; a tie to arm 0

outcome_learners.declared: Pipeline(PolynomialFeatures(2, interaction_only=True, include_bias=False), LogisticRegression(C=1e6, max_iter=5000, tol=1e-10)) on (A, W1, W2, Z)
outcome_learners.drop_w1: the columns (A, W2, Z), PolynomialFeatures(3, interaction_only=True, include_bias=False), LogisticRegression(C=1e6, max_iter=5000, tol=1e-10)

cells.learned: the primary (cde_z0, cde_z1) and interval_calibration learned_z0, learned_z1 (SE x 0.80, noise and term_dropped controls)
cells.known: interval_calibration known_z0, known_z1 (SE x 0.80, noise and term_dropped controls)
cells.drop_w1: targeting_necessity: targeted value against the untargeted plug-in

configuration.variance: V^-2 sum_v n_v^-2 sum_{i in v} D_i^2 of the raw fold curves, uncentred within each fold (JCI App B)
configuration.term_dropped: the same variance of the curve with H = 1{A = d} / g, without 1{Z = z} / q; the harness also requires the curve with the factor to give the reported variance within a relative 1e-8
configuration.truth: per replication and level: refit each fold's outcome learner on the fit's training rows with the package's fit_on_rows, take its rule at z, require it to equal the fit's rule on every validation row and the stored fold rule of the level on every row (rule L4), and integrate Qbar0(d_v(W), z, W) by the trapezoid rule on 4001 points of W1 for each W2; weight 1/V. The known rule's truth is its value at z by the same quadrature
configuration.oracle_se: sqrt(V^-2 sum_v Var D*_z(d_v) / n_v) at the fold rules; descriptive
